title: nr-llm: overview film
description: One AI setup for every TYPO3 extension. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 58 seconds: nr-llm for TYPO3 v14. Keys stay in the vault; Capabilities and usage; Named configurations; Test before you assign. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Each AI extension wants its own provider settings, its own API key and its own bill.
nr-llm keeps AI providers, models and configurations in one place.
Keys sit encrypted in nr-vault. The backend shows Configured, never the key.
Each model lists its capabilities, its context size and its usage over 30 days.
Features ask for a named configuration. Change its model, and every feature follows.
One click tests a configuration before any task uses it.
nr-llm by Netresearch. Usage and cost in one view.
